name: contract-risk
description: Legal: flag auto-renewal, uncapped liability and one-sided change clauses.

auto_renewal.instructions: Does `clause` make the contract or subscription renew or continue automatically unless someone acts to stop it?

unlimited_liability.instructions: Does `clause` leave the customer exposed to liability or indemnity with no cap, beyond carve-outs limited to fraud, gross negligence or willful misconduct?

unilateral_change.instructions: Does `clause` let the vendor change terms, prices or services without the customer signing an amendment?

state.clause: This Agreement renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least 60 days before the end of the then-current term.
Customer's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid in the twelve months preceding the claim.
Customer shall indemnify Vendor against any and all losses, without limitation, arising out of Customer's use of the Service.
Vendor may modify these Terms at any time by posting the revised Terms on its website; continued use constitutes acceptance.
Any amendment to this Agreement must be in writing and signed by authorized representatives of both parties.
The initial term is 24 months. Thereafter the parties may agree in writing to extend this Agreement.
Vendor reserves the right to change pricing upon 30 days' notice, and Customer may terminate if it does not accept the new pricing.
Nothing in this Agreement limits either party's liability for gross negligence, fraud, or willful misconduct.
Subscriptions continue month to month until cancelled by the Customer through the account dashboard.

The limitations of liability in Section 9 shall not apply to Customer's payment obligations or to Customer's breach of Section 4 (Acceptable Use), for which Customer shall be liable for all resulting damages.
本合同期满后自动续展一年，除非任一方在期满前三十日书面通知对方不再续约。
服务商有权根据业务需要随时调整服务内容及收费标准，调整后的条款自公布之日起生效。
